body: Good catch. I always forget cpp is not like gdscript. This wouldn't be a problem because this method is called only once per instance of this object but better safe than sorry.
changed it to `SceneStringName(visibility_changed)` and confirmed it works both from Accept and X buttons
ah nice, wasn't sure if there was one that covered both.
tricky part is it also emits when popup shows, but since i connect after showing, and dlg frees on hide, there should be no risk ™️
